What a tremor, what a rumble, What a gruesome grating, grumble, What a reeling, what a quaking! This way first, then that way shaking! But you'll not see us budge an inch, However close the dreadful pinch, Even though all Hell broke loose! Now a mound out of the ground Rises up with a dreadful sound. We know him well, for who but he Raised fair Delos from the sea, Grizzled old codger, from ocean’s floor, To give mother Leto a shore to bear Bright 福玻斯 and his sister there. Now thrusting, squeezing, straining, prying, Arms stretched taut and shoulders plying, 阿特拉斯-like he lifts his shoulders, Heaves up soil and massive boulders, Sand and gravel, shale and clay, Where once our tranquil river lay. Across our peaceful valley floor He cuts a gap and then no more. For like a massive caryatid, Waist-deep in the bare earth squatted, He stops, unmoving, without a groan, Bearing a monstrous weight of stone, Nearer he will not approach, Nor upon our haunt encroach.

@@U03342@@
All this is my doing, mine alone, as the world will one day concede. What would your earth have been without the beauty my jostling and jolting gave it? And your mountains, soaring splendidly into the sky,
translation:
@@U03340@@
多么震颤，多么隆隆，多么可怕的刺耳声，多么令人震惊，多么颤抖！先这边晃动，再那边晃动！但你不会看到我们移动一寸， 无论可怕的挤压多么接近， 即使地狱都崩溃了！现在，一座土丘从地里升起，发出可怕的声音。我们很了解他，除了他之外，他还为谁从海上升起了美丽的提洛岛，从海底升起了头发斑白的老家伙，为母亲莱托提供了一个海岸，让明亮的福玻斯和他的妹妹在那里生活。现在，推挤、挤压、用力、撬动， 双臂绷紧，肩膀滚动，阿特拉斯般地抬起肩膀， 举起土壤和巨石， 沙子和砾石，页岩和粘土， 曾经是我们宁静的河流所在的地方。他在我们宁静的谷底切开了一道缝隙，然后就再也没有了。因为就像一个巨大的女像柱，蹲在齐腰深的光秃秃的土地上，他停了下来，一动不动，没有呻吟，承载着巨大的石头重量，他不会靠近，也不会侵犯我们的出没。

@@U03342@@
这一切都是我做的，我一个人做的，有一天世界会承认这一点。如果没有我的推挤和震动所带来的美丽，你的地球会是什么样子？还有你的山脉，壮丽地高耸入云，
